tour.title: Project Overview & Dependencies
tour.description: Start with the project documentation and dependencies to understand Altron's architecture, prerequisites, and features.

tour.title: Application Bootstrap & Main Orchestrator
tour.description: Examine how main.py launches and coordinates concurrent threads (Flask HUD, voice listener, Telegram worker) with fault isolation.

tour.title: Dynamic Island Capsule UI & Tray
tour.description: Explore the PySide6 floating capsule window that smoothly expands for user interaction and collapses when idle, alongside system tray controls.

tour.title: Agent Execution Engine & Security
tour.description: Understand the autonomous ReAct agent loop, multi-step tool execution, memory retrieval, and the security permission gate.

tour.title: Desktop Automation & Win32 Tools
tour.description: Inspect the tool system allowing Altron to control Windows SysListView32 desktop icons, read/write files, and run commands.

tour.title: Voice Wake-Word & Edge-TTS Pipeline
tour.description: Learn how ambient listening detects 'Altron' and coordinates speech playback with audio feedback prevention.

tour.title: Remote Telegram Control & Web HUD
tour.description: See how users can control Altron remotely from a smartphone via Telegram bot long-polling, and monitor live status on the Flask HUD.

tour.title: Persistence Engine & Configuration
tour.description: Review the SQLite database layer for chat history and settings persistence, alongside environment variable handling.
